1.mascotDialogue: Same visited-tracking idea as BFS, tesoro, but an entirely different order! DFS dives deep first, and only comes back up when she truly must.

2.mascotDialogue: Line 6, this is the whole difference from BFS — instead of queuing the neighbor for later, DFS recurses into her right away, going deep before ever checking the next sibling.

3.mascotDialogue: Same graph as the BFS lesson, entirely different order — 3 is visited before 2, because DFS committed to 1 first, and rode that path all the way down!

4.mascotDialogue: DFS's recursive elegance, she is also her biggest risk — forget the visited check, and 'go deep' has no bottom to hit. She simply keeps calling herself, forever.
